plain: Baby steps, updated as they happen. Each line is one concrete thing being done right now; done lines stay for the day so you can see the trail.

steps.text: Film-window detector rewritten around motion and brightness; matches the hand-found answer on the snow game
49ers–Rams (clear game) registered, probed, film window found, proxy built, official plays pulled, 406 takes found
Camera-angle labelling does not transfer between games with the hand-tuned feature; two replacements failed
Contact-sheet tool built; 42 takes labelled; layout classifier trained (86% leave-one-out)
Spike-based cut detection: 286 takes against 282 implied by the play list (was 406)
Pairing takes to plays: take alignment on dense camera readings; both games index cleanly and every kick lands on its film
SAM 3 on the M4: 0.16 frames/s sustained (fanless Air), 236 h a game; 3.5 h for the 2,000-frame labelling set
Spike GRD-95: SAM 3D Body fits All-22 players at about 1 s each; 25 of 27 crops good or rough, fitted bodies for everyone
Camera labels were swapped in both games (SIDELINE was the end-zone camera); names, model, tests and charts corrected
1080p copy of 49ers–Rams on the drive (owner downloaded it): frame for frame with the 576p copy, linked as film_1080p.mp4

Owner, optional and about 2 minutes: glance over the camera label sheets on the drive (camera_labels_sideline.jpg, camera_labels_endzone.jpg in the game's folder). Claude checked them first: 83 of 86 right, 3 sideline takes labelled end zone now corrected
Labelling loop built: sampler, SAM 3 teacher, review page, student training (GRD-28 to GRD-31)
SAM 3 teacher: both games done (2,000 frames each, 3.4 and 3.8 h)
Review page tested in Chrome and fixed (boxes were not drawn); ball boxes below 0.4 cut after an eyeball check
Round-0 students trained on both games in two folds (mAP50 0.94 against the teacher on unseen plays); review pages reordered by their disagreement
Tracked plays 1-10 of 49ers–Rams with a round-0 student: overlay videos with ids and team colours on the drive (overlays folder); ids hold through play 10, benches still tracked as players
Tracking marks player tracks standing off the field (sideline takes) and draws them grey; catches benches when the sideline paint is in shot
49ers–Rams relabelled by SAM 3 from the 1080p copy: twice the balls on sideline frames, players nearly the same; review page rebuilt (576p page kept in frames_576p)
Plays 1-10 retracked from the 1080p copy: same tracks as at 576p (the detector sees 960 px either way); sharper overlays on the drive

Milestone 4 first light: pixel-to-yards on sideline frames of the clear game (65% of sampled frames easy), anchored to the official line of scrimmage; 69 of 69 anchored frames agree with the painted yard numbers
Benches: tracking now judges off-field in yards where the frame registers; both benches mostly grey on the overlays (256 tracks off against 152)

Milestone 4 proof, first half: bird's-eye videos of plays 1-10 from the sideline camera (birdseye folder on the drive); 9 of 10 in absolute yards (p001, a kickoff, stays relative), yard lines on the painted ones by eye

Bird's-eye chain held out on plays 11-60 (never looked at while building): 45 of 47 scrimmage plays anchored, yard lines on the painted ones on all 46 frames checked by eye; the two failures refused safely (an end-zone goal-line frame, tracker team colours)

Tracks that swap ids between opposing linemen are cut where their colour changes: plays 1-60 relabelled, the bird's-eye videos rebuilt; p029 now anchors, fronts right on 52 of 56 takes (47 of 55 before)
Review: bench pre-removal judged in yards on the first 600 frames of the 49ers-Rams page, and a picture guide on the drive (review_guide.html)
Runpod connected to Claude Code for labelling and training rounds; nothing run on it yet
Owner reviewed 234 frames of the snow game: 196 kept (483 boxes removed), 15 dropped, 23 flagged; imported as its first approved labels
Owner reviewed 210 frames of 49ers-Rams on the rebuilt page: 175 kept, 17 dropped, 18 flagged; of 2,724 pre-removals only 35 restored (33 officials, 2 players); imported
Round 1 student on 371 approved frames: bench 'players' on random 49ers-Rams sideline frames fell from 4.2 a frame to 0.1, officials on the field held; the snow game did not move

Is this many frames enough? Twice the frames added 0.006 player mAP50 and 0.021 for officials: close to flat for players in these two games; a stricter box merge clears most stacked boxes on linemen with no labelling

Plays 1-60 tracked with held-out round-1 students: sideline tracks 5,584 to 3,144, off-field tracks 1,304 to 16, fronts right on 54 of 56 (52 before); but about 0.6 fewer players a frame before the snap, real linemen lost in the clump. Tracking stays on round 0 for now

Third game on the drive: Chargers at Chiefs, week 6, 1080p, hard sun and shadow. Registered, 143 of 144 plays matched to the film, 2,000 frames sampled. First unseen-game test: no extra sideline boxes, and frames with 20-24 players up to 94% before the snap and 83% in the play
Film window no longer loses the shaded part of a recording (it dropped the first 26 minutes of this game); the other two recordings come out unchanged

Owner reviewed the 40 test frames of Chargers-Chiefs (38 kept): the first fair score on a game neither model trained on. Players: precision 0.80 to 0.95 with recall holding at 0.95-0.96. False boxes 173 to 34, missed 29 to 35. Tracking moves to the round-1 student

Bird's-eye works at a second stadium: each game's camera is now measured from its own frames (51 yd up at Arrowhead, 27 at the 49ers-Rams game). First two plays pinned to the official line within 0.12 yd

Chargers-Chiefs plays 1-60 tracked with the round-1 student, with overlay and bird's-eye videos: tracks and boxes held up, but team colours failed in shade, leaving 38 of 55 plays anchored and fronts right on only 22 of 38

Team colours fixed for shade: a crop is brightened by how dark the ground beside it is. Plays 1-60 of Chargers-Chiefs: anchored 38 to 53 of 55, fronts right 22 of 38 to 49 of 53. The other two games barely move (99.8% and 98.6% of crops unchanged)

Held out on plays 61-120, run with nothing changed: 49 of 55 anchored, median 0.14 yd from the official line, fronts right on 48 of 50, yard lines on the paint and teams right by eye on 50 random frames. The 6 misses all saw no snap: 3 field goals, 2 goal-line runs and one other. Overlay and bird's-eye videos of plays 1-120 are on the drive

Owner saw players vanish and come back during the play. Measured on 50 plays: 1,313 dropouts and 594 restarts in 5 minutes of live play. Only 24% of missing moments were the detector seeing nothing; 36% were a box the tracker threw away

Broken tracks now rejoined after tracking, within a team, and gaps up to a second filled and drawn thin. Dropouts 1,313 to 36, players missing 4.5% of the time to 0.8%, frames in play with 20-24 players 54% to 72%. About 7 visible breaks a play remain, against about 38

Whole game done: all 143 plays tracked, with overlay and bird's-eye videos on the drive. Plays 121-143 run for the first time with everything in place: 19 of 21 anchored, fronts right on 17 of 19, 21-23 players on 95% of frames before the snap

NFL shield tracked as a player on dozens of Arrowhead plays. The approved labels are clean, so the model has simply never seen it as background; it needs training on it. Until then a track that wide joins nothing
